messages:
anya: Quick sync — postmortem follow-up for last week's auth + model-registry outage. Putting action items in one thread. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-model-registry-auth-outage
ops-bot: Incident severity downgraded to SEV3, timeline archived (auto).
chris: TL;DR — root cause was token exchange throttling in vendor auth + our single-region model-registry endpoint. Two prongs: vendor rate limits + no regional fallback.
selina: agree. I sketched mitigations in the doc but we need owners + due dates.
geo: assigning network/infra follow-ups to me. I'll validate cloud provider BGP flap mitigation and ask infra to enable cross-region replication for registry metadata.
matt: from runtime side I'll add an emergency degraded-mode that uses cached manifests (TTL 10m) when registry auth fails. Can't be permanent but prevents hard outage.
chris: action list I'm proposing (short):
1) circuit breaker around model-registry auth calls — owner: chris — due: 2026-04-02 
2) regional model-registry replicas + read fallback — owner: geo — due: 2026-04-09 
3) cached manifests degraded mode (runtime) — owner: matt — due: 2026-03-30 
4) vendor auth SLA/quotas review + notify vendor for rate-limit increase — owner: selina — due: 2026-03-28 
5) runbook + canary for auth failover — owner: anya — due: 2026-03-29
(Also: create tasks in tracker and link to postmortem)
selina: created tracker ticket TASK-723 and linked to postmortem. Will add vendor contact notes and current quota metrics.
anya: copying tasks into the incident action tracker: INC-4821. Please put the TASK IDs in your PR descriptions so the reviewer can cross-check.
matt: quick question on (3) — TTL 10m ok? worried about stale models for long-running sessions.
chris: TTL tradeoff noted. We'll add a validation step: if cached manifest age > 10m, block model pulls for new sessions and surface a degradated warning. Add to runtime PR.
geo: infra note: cross-region replication will need schema compatibility check. I'll schedule a short design doc and call it out in TASK-723.
product-lead: please mark any UX-visible degradations so product can coordinate customer comms and set appropriate SLAs.
anya: putting a recurring 30-day "dependency outage review" on the incidents calendar to track patterns. Owner rotation: selina -> chris -> geo each month.
chris: also proposing an automated alert: if model-registry auth failures spike above 0.5% for 5m, open a P1 channel and run a quick throttling checklist. Will add alert rule (ops runbook attached).
selina: vendor follow-up: I already asked for a meeting next Wed with vendor SREs to walk quotas and increase headroom. Will post minutes.
ops-bot: Reminder: please update INC-4821 with status changes. Next sync scheduled: 2026-03-31 10:00 UTC.
anya: OK — owners confirm by EOD? please react with :thumbsup: when you've accepted assigned due date so I can lock the tracker.
geo: :thumbsup: I accept.
matt: :thumbsup: working on PR branch w/ cached fallback.
selina: :thumbsup: vendor meeting scheduled.
chris: :thumbsup: I'll open the circuit breaker PR today and link TASK-723.
anya: thanks. After owners sign off I'll close loop and update the postmortem with the action table.
chris: one more note — repeating pattern: we've seen two auth/registry incidents in 6 months, both correlated with cloud provider network blips. Propose adding a metric to track "cross-region fallback hit rate" so we can see long-term regression.
product-lead: agree, add to quarterly reliability KPIs.
anya: Great. I'll capture the follow-ups and send a short summary to #all-hands once actions are in the tracker.
ops-bot: Task INC-4821 updated: 5 open action items, 3 owners assigned.
selina: closing loop — vendor requested our request for increased quota in writing; I'll attach to TASK-723 and set a follow-up reminder in 7 days.
anya: End of thread for now — please keep updates in INC-4821/TASK-723. If anything blocks, ping this thread.
